tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((document-creation-time :depends-on s5q)
               (document-creation-time :before s5c)
               (s5c :before s5s)
               (s5q :contained s5k)
               (s5k :overlap s5p)
               (document-creation-time :overlap s5y)
               (s5y :overlap s5x))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s5s)
            (author :full-affirmative s5c)
            (author :full-affirmative s5k)
            (author :full-affirmative s5p)
            (author :full-affirmative s5y)
            (s5y :partial-affirmative s5x))
    :coref ((s3w :same-entity s5h)
            (s3p2 :same-event s5p)))

**Temporal:** 去年 (last year) is a relative date, so I hung it on the document creation time. The start of the discharge (开始) falls inside last year. The discharge itself (排放) overlaps that start, because it began in batches and is still going on. The storage (储存) is marked as before the document creation time because of 已 ("already"). The use of the water (使用) comes before the storage. The forecast (预计) is a present state. The 40 years the discharge will take (需) is its complement, so I attached it to the forecast with an overlap.

**Modal:** The author plainly asserts every event except the 40-year duration, which is only forecast. I made the forecast (预计) its conceiver with partial-affirmative, matching the strength already in the sentence graph.

**Coreference:**
- The nuclear wastewater (核废水) links to its closest earlier mention, the "treated water" (处理水) in sentence 3.
- The discharge (排放) links as the same event to the release into the sea (排海) in sentence 3.

**Choices you may want to check:**
- I did not use the 12-year duration as a time anchor.
- Ordering the use before the storage is an inference.
- Treating the discharge as the same event as sentence 3's release into the sea is my reading; a gold annotation might leave that link out.
